hints.title: Bitwise Disjoint Condition
hints.text: Two numbers share no common set bits if and only if their bitwise and evaluates to zero.

hints.title: Descending Sort Pruning
hints.text: Sort unique values in descending order to test larger potential products first.

hints.title: Upper Bound Early Break
hints.text: Stop iterating when the square of the current element cannot exceed the best product found.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: U: number of unique elements in nums
complexity.notes: Sorted pair inspection with early termination pruning.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating duplicate pairs in unreduced arrays wastes operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Deduplicates elements into a vector of size U.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bitwise AND equality to zero with early break optimizations.
